summary: NEW ROOT PROPOSAL, provisional: qld, II. Only mqaldile is attested; the proposed mqaləd base is an explicit morphological inference, and no Preterit form is supplied.

The sequence concerns preventing spoilage of butterfat, processing it, letting it drain into a clean vessel and storing it in a canister. This supports a technical clarification gloss; it does not independently identify boiling, frying or the precise temperature/process.

The permitted qlḏ lookup has III maqlaḏle/maqləḏ 'verschliessen', which differs in stem pattern, final consonant spelling and meaning. qly II has mqalele/mqale 'braten, rösten'; its relation to the present form is unresolved.

Permitted search mqald returned no hits. Form lookup mqaldile produced weak-root and diacritic-insensitive candidates, not an exact established lexeme. Do not mistake those candidates for identification.
The text treats u məšḥano as the object. The possible mqald-i-le segmentation gives plural agents and a singular masculine object; this is a hypothesis based on one token.
